elements.p: Every captain needs a place to come home to: somewhere to moor the ship, hang the hammock and count the gold.
Plant your flag to claim a HIDEOUT. You can have one. Within its claim no monsters spawn naturally: 32 blocks at first, 48 and then 64 as you upgrade it. Use the flag to set your respawn point there.
Hold pirate coins and use the flag to raise it: 64 coins for tier 2, 128 more for tier 3. At tier 3 you regenerate while at home. Break the flag to give up the claim.
A Mooring Post holds any ship within 12 blocks in place and slowly repairs its hull. Inside your own hideout it counts as your HOME PORT and repairs twice as fast.
Build with palm wood, thatch, woven screens, driftwood fences, rope ladders and rope bridges. Tiki torches light the beach.
A captain's desk, a sea chest that keeps its contents when broken, chairs and barrel stools you can sit on, a map table, rum racks, nets and rope coils, and a display cannon for show.
Add coins to it and the pile grows, through eight sizes. A big enough hoard brings you luck, and even a hero's welcome.
Pineapple, lime and chili grow here. The seeds turn up in island grass, and the Quartermaster sells them too.
A Rum Still needs a fire lit under it to make raw rum. Leave it in an Aging Cask and it becomes aged, and in time vintage. Drinking too much makes you Tipsy.

At a Trading Post you can sell a held stack for three quarters of its worth in doubloons (up to 64 items a day), or pay 32 doubloons to hire a trader to stand at it. A Bounty Board offers three contracts a day: a hunt, a delivery, or a ship to sink.
Bet up to 16 pirate coins at the roulette table. Anyone nearby can join in before the wheel spins.

Light a Forge Hearth with coal, charcoal or brimstone and set a Forge Anvil beside it. Lay a weapon, tool or piece of armour on the anvil, add its materials, and strike with the Smith's Hammer. Bellows at the hearth save you a couple of blows.
Lay a damaged piece with its own repair material and three blows make it good again. There's no cost in experience and nothing is ever too expensive.
Some weapons can only be forged and never found. The Pattern Board lists every one. Brannoc's forge in town never goes out.

Fifteen kinds fly these islands, from the common green parakeet to the legendary Ember Macaw and the Kraken's Pet. Tame a wild one with seeds, buy one of today's birds from Polly Marlowe, or open a Parrot Crate from a treasure chest.
On your shoulder a parrot keeps lookout and squawks at danger.

elements.row: Kakapo - pecks at whatever you're fighting
Ember Macaw - spits fire at your foes
Ghost Parrot - takes over a lesser monster and fights for you
Kraken's Pet - snatches you back from a killing blow

elements.p: A bird that spends itself like that is gone for half a day, then comes home.
The Roost keeps a record of every kind you have owned, with a silhouette for each one you haven't. Call any of yours to your shoulder from it. Perch Branches give birds somewhere to sit.

Agatha's Cattery has four cats a day for sale, from plain tabbies to the Ghost Cat and the Sea Witch's Cat, priced by how rare they are. Keep your own cat near you and the sea gives you luck: better catches and better loot.

elements.quote: Every ship needs a cat. Most ships need a better captain.

elements.row: Captain's Spyglass - read a creature or a ship at a distance
Compass of Desire - home, your death, treasure, or your next quarry
Grappling Hook - bite into a block and reel yourself in
Telescope - put your eye to it: zoom, bearings, names

elements.quote: Keep your powder dry and your blade sharper.
